verdict.rationale: Meta's first-party safety blog documents that conversation trajectories are used in training after PII sanitization, and that users who do not want their data used in model training at all can opt out with a simple switch in Muse settings. That directly delivers the user-controlled training opt-out. Training use is on by default and opt-out only, and the claim rests on a single vendor source. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the settings switch exists and works, and detail on scope (e.g., whether it covers WhatsApp chats and is retroactive).
